collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A young pig decides a villager is its favorite person and follows everywhere: accept the escort, or try to lose it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A young pig has decided that (subject) is its favorite person. Nobody knows why. It follows (subject.him/her) to the field, to the stream, to the latrine \(where it waits outside, politely\), and to the evening gathering, where it sits beside (subject.him/her) in the circle as though it has every right to be there.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) gives in. All week the pig trots ahead of (subject.him/her) on the paths like a scout and stands guard while (subject.he/she) bathes. Then, one morning, it simply trots off after somebody else and never looks back. (subject) feels oddly abandoned. "Fickle," says (friend). "Very fickle," agrees (subject).

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) takes the long way round, doubles back and hides behind a tree. The pig is sitting on the other side of the tree, waiting. (subject) wades across the stream. The pig, offended, finds a dry way round and is waiting on the far bank. (subject) gives up and shares (subject.his/her) lunch, which the pig seems to consider the correct ending all along.
